text:
sophie: Quick RFC follow-up: propose "sparse-lease" tokens to shrink rollout metadata for big tenants. idea: leases are minimal pointers (lease_id + ttl + optional affinity/hints) instead of embedding full model refs. tradeoffs below. @rahul @jamie PTAL

rahul: That could cut storage/egress. How does a client act when it sees an unknown lease_id?

sophie: Servers will accept both old `pin` objects and new `lease` tokens. Clients should treat unknown lease ids as a soft miss: call resolver endpoint to fetch the full model_ref. Resolver returns 200 + `resolution_hint` if found, or 404 if missing.

jamie: Need a compatibility rollout. Suggest 3 phases: 1) accept+telemetry, 2) server-side resolution cache + background backfill, 3) deprecate embedded pins after ~6 months.

rahul: We'll ship an SDK helper `resolveLease(lease_id)` for background caching. Non-blocking by default; on failure fall back to primary model. Keep p95 latency unchanged.

sophie: Also add `lease_kind` enum: `full` (current pin), `sparse` (pointer), `ephemeral` (single-use/canary). example token in-thread: 
```
{ "lease_kind":"sparse", "lease_id":"hmac:abcd...", "ttl_seconds":"7200", "affinity":"region:us-west-2", "hints":"stable" }
```
(kept tiny)

tess: Telemetry asks: tag requests that went through lease resolution, emit resolution latency histogram, and count lease->model changes over time. We'll need a dashboard and alert thresholds.

jamie: Server-side: keep a resolution cache (LRU+TTL) and a lazy fetch queue to avoid synchronous blocking. Also create a migration job to convert heavy tenants to sparse mode gradually.

rahul: Security: lease_id must be non-guessable (HMAC KMS-signed). If affinity encodes tenant info, redact or hash it in telemetry. Also include `compat_version` on tokens.

sophie: Good. We'll use lease_id = hmac(kms_key, model_ref|epoch|rand) and bump compat_version when format changes.

jamie: API: read path accepts both `{ pin:... }` and `{ lease:... }`. New writes use lease when tenant opts in. Feature flag `use_sparse_lease` per tenant.

tess: Rollout plan: 1% canary for an internal tenant for 48h. Fail if resolution miss_rate > 1% or resolution p95 > 200ms. We'll also emit `lease_migration` tags: created/resolved/evicted/expired/renewed.

rahul: SDK docs + non-breaking adapter needed. Adapter maps lease resolution to model refs and retries with exponential backoff on transient failures. Call out unresolved lease as transient in changelog.

sophie: Edge case: lease resolves to a different model mid-session. Propose `session_stickiness` info in resolver response: `resolved_at` + `resolved_model_id`. Clients can keep prior model if they prefer.

jamie: Server policy: default stickiness = min(lease_ttl, 300s), configurable per tenant.

tess: Add telemetry for "resolution flood" events and an ops dashboard. Also tag resolution responses with `resolved_from_cache` boolean.

ops-bot: deploybot: Created canary for `internal-canary-3` with `use_sparse_lease=true` at 2026-03-23T15:12:00Z :rocket:

rahul: Next steps: I'll draft SDK adapter PR (non-breaking). @sophie will draft server resolver + cache design doc. @tess will write metrics/dashboard spec. Schedule the 1% canary next week.

sophie: I'll open the design doc today with HMAC format, compat_version migration plan, and the rollout checklist. Add an ops playbook for resolution overload: auto-scale, circuit-break to full pins, and alert.

jamie: Also add an alert for repeated lease churn (lease resolving to different models frequently).

sophie: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:
